categories.label: Community health center (FQHC)
categories.source: HRSA Health Center Service Delivery Sites
categories.coverage_note: 4 mobile units also serve this county (8–32 hours a week), and are not included in these travel times — HRSA publishes only their dispatch address, not where they park. Ask the health center for the schedule.

categories.label: Dental care
categories.source: NPPES NPI Registry + HRSA health center sites
categories.coverage_note: 1 mobile unit also serves this county, and is not included in these travel times — HRSA publishes only their dispatch address, not where they park. Ask the health center for the schedule. Solo and small private practices are not included — they enumerate as individuals rather than organizations, and their listed address is often a home address, so mapping them would publish private residences. The real number of practices is higher than the count here.
